t: If the revenues of the Post Office Department shall be insufficient to meet the appropriations made under this title, a sum equal to such deficency in the revenues is hereby appropriated, to be paid out of any money in the Treasury not otherwise appropriated, to supply such deficiency in the revenues for the current fiscal year, and the sum needed may be advanced to the Post Office Department upon requisition of the Postmaster General.

fable.w: This is a deficiency appropriation that lets Treasury funds cover Post Office Department revenue shortfalls. The only procedural step is a requisition by the Postmaster General, a federal official, so every actor is inside the federal government. The tempting reading treats the 'requisition' as a consultative step, but it is an internal funding request with no outside party, comment period, hearing, advisory body or right to sue.
fable.s: the sum needed may be advanced to the Post Office Department upon requisition of the Postmaster General

qwen_block.w: This section describes a funding mechanism for the Post Office Department, specifically appropriating funds to cover revenue deficiencies. It involves only internal federal government actors (the Treasury and the Postmaster General) and does not require consultation, coordination, or participation with any outside parties such as the public, states, or private entities.
qwen_block.s: If the revenues of the Post Office Department shall be insufficient to meet the appropriations made under this title, a sum equal to such deficency in the revenues is hereby appropriated, to be paid out of any money in the Treasury not otherwise appropriated, to supply such deficiency in the revenues for the current fiscal year, and the sum needed may be advanced to the Post Office Department upon requisition of the Postmaster General.

opus.w: This section is an appropriation that covers Post Office revenue shortfalls with money from the Treasury. The only actors are the Post Office Department, the Postmaster General, and the Treasury, all of which are inside the federal government. The 'requisition' is a funding request from one federal office to another, not consultation with outsiders. There is no hearing, comment period, advisory body, rulemaking, or right to sue.
opus.s: the sum needed may be advanced to the Post Office Department upon requisition of the Postmaster General
opus.b: Step 1: Someone might read "requisition of the Postmaster General" as a formal process. It is not participation. A requisition is the Postmaster General, a federal official, asking the Treasury for money. Everyone involved is inside the federal government, and no outside party takes part in any decision.
